label: r1b_ollama
model_note: ollama server, weights: mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit (ollama create); text prompts = tokenizer decode of the ids; EOS not ignorable (tokens counted as they arrive)

metric_notes.ttft: seconds from submit (all of a level's requests at t0) to the first token; includes queueing
metric_notes.gpu_util_pct: IOReport GPUPH active residency (not power-gated) over the window; includes other apps; compare with idle_gpu_active_pct; not a busy-cycle counter (needs root)
metric_notes.cpu_util_pct: process CPU time / wall over the window, all threads (100 = one core)
metric_notes.process_peak_rss_gb: resource.getrusage ru_maxrss (bytes on macOS), whole run

energy_boundary: IOReport 'GPU Energy' rail (SoC energy model), whole GPU incl. idle; Mac-only
idle_note: measured over idle_window_s with the model loaded; 0.0 W with 0% active = GPU power-gated (the IOReport counter did not advance), not a missing reading

rows.window: whole run (never reached level in flight)
whole run (never reached level in flight)

note_run: rerun after the window run crashed: the harness now reports whole-run throughput when the engine never reaches level in flight (Ollama MLX runner: max_in_flight 1); per-level 1
